cause.what_happened: At 07:01 ET on 2026-10-01 Foghorn filed an 8-K (items 2.05/7.01) saying the Phase 1 dose escalation of FHD-909 (LY4050784) did not show enough efficacy, that Lilly and Foghorn will advance neither FHD-909 nor the SMARCA2 degrader and expect no further collaboration activities, and that it will cut ~40% of its workforce and guide runway into 2H29. Today, 2026-10-02, the stock fell a further ~30% to the 15:04 ET screen, 86% of it intraday, on 4.6x volume. I found no separate catalyst dated today.

findings.finding: Foghorn has an at-the-market facility with about $100m of capacity unused (nothing sold in H1 2026). It can be drawn on any night, including tonight, and would sell into any bounce on 2026-10-05.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM needs no new registration event and can be drawn from the drop-day close through 2026-10-05. This lands inside the window only if the issuer chooses to draw.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ATM sales in H1 2026 (10-Q). I found no observed reaction to a past draw.
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds the lost asset. It does not hold supply over the bounce. That said, the company just guided runway into 2H29 and the stock trades near cash, so a draw at these levels is unlikely, which keeps this small. If it were priced you would expect a 424B5 or heavy close-auction supply. None is visible.
findings.independence: Earlier filings carry the same ATM language (10-K 2026-03-11, 10-Q 2026-05-07). The 2026-10-01 runway guide argues against a near-term draw: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1822462/000162828026064102/exhibit991foghornpressrele.htm

outside_window.finding: Near or below net cash: 59.4m shares plus 11.9m pre-funded warrants is about 71.3m, about $146m at $2.05, against $167.6m of cash and securities at 2026-06-30 (less Q3 burn). There is no dated mechanism that closes this gap by 2026-10-05.
$229.8m of Lilly deferred revenue (2026-06-30) will likely be accelerated now that the collaboration has ended. This is non-cash and lands in a later report.
The workforce cut finishes in Q4 2026, with $2.3m of cash charges.
